name: ClawsBench
titleZh: ClawsBench：在模拟工作区中评测生产力智能体的能力与安全
summary: Five high-fidelity mock services with real state management and deterministic snapshot/restore, plus 44 tasks from single-service to cross-service.
summaryZh: 五个高保真模拟服务，具备完整状态管理与可确定复现的快照／回滚，配 44 个从单服务到跨服务的任务。
keyFact: ClawsBench (Li et al., arXiv:2604.05172, first posted 2026-04-06) mocks Gmail, Slack, Google Calendar, Google Docs and Google Drive with deterministic snapshot/restore, precisely so agents can be tested without risking irreversible changes to live accounts.
keyFactZh: ClawsBench（Li 等，arXiv:2604.05172，2026-04-06 首次提交）用可确定复现的快照／回滚模拟 Gmail、Slack、Google Calendar、Google Docs 与 Google Drive，正是为了能在不冒「真实账号被不可逆修改」风险的前提下测试智能体。
whyItMatters: Snapshot and restore is the practical prerequisite before letting an agent touch anything with side effects.
whyItMattersZh: 快照与回滚，是让智能体去碰任何有副作用的东西之前必须先具备的前提。
title: ClawsBench: Evaluating Capability and Safety of LLM Productivity Agents in Simulated Workspaces
